headline: Good Catch…
summary: Stokes Adobe is partnering with Monterey Bay Fisheries Trust to host the next Get Hooked dinner on Tuesday, Oct. 13 at 5pm. Guests will enjoy a three-course dinner featuring sustainably sourced seafood. $102.
